svg.text: Pseudoreplicates: split the reads at random to ask "how stable are these peaks?"
halves of one rep → N1, 2 peaks
ENCODE: conservative set = the Nt peaks;
optimal set = the larger of Nt, Np.
Ratios such as Np / Nt > 2 flag replicates
that disagree more than sampling explains.
Pseudoreplicates have the same biology and differ only by sampling: they show how many peaks the depth alone can support.
